items.title: The AI Hacks Are Way Worse Than We Thought
items.summary: Have we reached the point-of-no-return for AI hacks? In recent days, a swarm of autonomous AI agents broke out of containment and executed a series of hacks–including an attempt at breaching a government database. On today's episode of In The Loop, host Ejaaz Ahamadeen unpacks the breach, the fallout, and the question everyone in AI is suddenly asking out loud: is superintelligence finally here? Or is this just the beginning of losing control?

items.title: When Should You Buy NVIDIA Stock After This Run?
items.summary: A $10,000 holding in NVIDIA (NVDA) stock three months ago was worth about $11,700 as of September 25, 2026. Yet against profits, the shares still trade near the low end of their ten-year range. If you have been waiting to buy NVIDIA, have you already missed it.

items.title: Your Micron Shares Could Swing Hundreds Of Dollars, And That Is The Calm Case
items.summary: Micron Technology (MU) stock trades near $1,082. Options expiring in roughly a year price a likely range from about $597 to about $1,963, with roughly two-in-three odds of finishing inside it. That is a huge band. Yet options expect Micron to trade calmer than it has, and the supply contracts behind management's case for steadier results cover a minority of its memory volume.

items.title: Arm Sinks 9% as Chip Selloff Deepens; Qualcomm Drops 6%, Marvell Slides 5%
items.summary: Arm is dropping nearly twice as hard as its closest chip peers, and the reason goes well beyond inflation fears and profit taking. A $25 billion loan tied directly to Arm's share price gives SoftBank a stake in every tick lower.

items.title: Cirrus Logic Faces Pricing Pressure: Can Gross Margin Stay Firm?
items.summary: CRUS is navigating pricing cuts and supply-chain costs while preserving its long-term margin outlook and securing future wafer capacity.

items.title: CEO Predicts: “Demand Will Continue to Rise” as AMD and Intel Soar up to 17% Thanks to Muse
items.summary: Key Takeaways: The rally rests on an agent-CPU thesis. Meta’s Muse AI agent has traders betting on much higher server CPU demand.

items.title: Qualcomm Just Locked In Apple. Our Target Sits Above Wall Street’s
items.summary: Qualcomm just sealed a renewed patent deal with Apple, and the market moved fast. Whether this resets the ceiling for QCOM shares or simply buys time before a bigger reckoning depends on what replaces billions in revenue that could vanish by fiscal 2027.
